newsitems.title: Steam Client Update - October 21st
newsitems.author: lostgoat_*****
newsitems.contents: [p]A new Steam Client update has been released and will be automatically downloaded.[/p][p][/p][p][b]General[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed some cases the Steam Service Error dialog was showing incorrectly if you quit/restarted Steam quickly.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an error displaying dates for users in British Columbia.[/p][/*][*][p]Updated certificate revocation lists.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Remote Play[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed a memory leak using NVENC to stream H.264 using unlimited bandwidth from Windows computers.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Linux[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed Vulkan games hanging after alt-tab.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a case where Steam updater UI would fail to show for some users.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]MacOS[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed client crash when opening some browser windows.[/p][/*][/list]

newsitems.title: Steam Client Update - October 13th
newsitems.author: mikela
newsitems.contents: [p]A new Steam Client update has been released and will be automatically downloaded.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Homescreen - Big Picture Mode[/b][/p][list][*][p]Added a new 'Big Art Mode' option for the home screen. This can be enabled in Settings > Home.[/p][/*][*][p]Added Personal Calendar to the Recommended tab on the home screen[/p][carousel][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_LOC_IMAGE}/27766192/03ebb301c5968af4cccce2854fbff30f91747e07.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_LOC_IMAGE}/27766192/7b7dab3dfc6ddfab476f80abf5ec599455f4dc50.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_LOC_IMAGE}/27766192/76b9199d544585a2559e662b3d1f84b4a6a0d2e0.png"][/img][/carousel][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]Screensaver - Big Picture Mode[/b][/p][list][*][p]Added a new screensaver feature, accessible in Settings > Customization. There are two screensavers available:[/p][list][*][p]The default is a game art slideshow that can be configured to show artwork from recently played games and your recent in-game screenshots.[/p][/*][*][p]A retro inspired bouncing logo screensaver[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Big Picture mode can also load custom screensavers. Similar to startup movies, they can be placed in the config\\uioverrides\\screensavers directory in your Steam install directory (e.g. C:\\Program Files (x86)\\Steam or ~/.steam/root). You can use the bouncing logo screensaver (in the steamui\\screensavers directory) as an example to get started.[/p][carousel][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_LOC_IMAGE}/27766192/d0385c58a927f1d3ae8dd70e878cf5faa9f4e3b5.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_LOC_IMAGE}/27766192/57cd6d630c6158aa8398942593ebaf2cde35b7aa.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_LOC_IMAGE}/27766192/cabd7808a3b81ab2d01dacae4ec9fbfe39f9d2c7.png"][/img][/carousel][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]General[/b][/p][list][*][p]Improved Steam Client startup performance.[/p][/*][*][p]Avoid stealing focus when the Steam main window opens, if another window was activated during startup/login.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved the text layout in achievement notifications when the name, description or both wrap across multiple lines.[/p][/*][*][p]Dialogs that appear for serious error conditions now stay above the main window.[/p][/*][*][p]On Windows, using the systray menu to exit while the Steam window is minimized will no longer flash the window visible briefly.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the onscreen keyboard not working the first time it is invoked on desktop.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed cases where users with older CPUs could have the client hang/crash when starting downloads for games with many identical files.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed desktop shortcuts always using the default launch option rather than your saved option.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a case where library playtime could temporarily show an incorrect value.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a case where after server maintenance some users might fail to auto-reconnect to Steam.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed bug where being prompted to refresh credentials more than once could trigger an immediate restart.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed "Suspend Download Throttle" not properly updating on the downloads page.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the Recordings & Screenshots dialog not showing all games that have related screenshots in the game filter dropdown.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a crash at launch on Windows with EZFRD64.DLL installed[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p][b]In-Game Overlay[/b][/p][list][*][p]Improved scaling of Performance Monitor FPS line graph for various text scaling settings values.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed crash when Vulkan games recreate their swapchain.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed frame rate hitches in D3D11 and D3D12 games when taking screenshots on Windows.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed rendering the overlay and using other overlay related features (screenshots, game recording, etc.) in Vulkan games that create multiple windows.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]Library[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed hovering DLCs not working in some places.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]Game Recording[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed some cases where playback would jump to an unexpected point in the timeline when reaching the end of a play session or clip.[/p][/*][*][p]Decreased performance impact of game recording for some D3D12 games on Windows.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]Big Picture Mode[/b][/p][list][*][p]Added delaying dimming the screen or displaying the screensaver when the Steam Store, web browsers or other apps request to disable monitor sleep and screensavers while playing video.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a setting to disable the screensaver when in game.[/p][/*][*][p]Added explicit warning text to power menu confirmation dialogs when proceeding will shut down an active game.[/p][/*][*][p]Added support for keyboard glyphs in the footer when using mouse/kb to interact with Big Picture Mode.[/p][/*][*][p]Using a physical mouse to click on text input will no longer bring up the On-Screen Keyboard.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved the layout of the QAM Voice Chat tab, added a mute toggle to the volume sliders, and fixed the link from the tab to the active chat to focus the textbox when opening to the chat window.[/p][/*][*][p]Updated default artwork when an app does not have library or hero artwork.[/p][/*][*][p]Reorganized the idle timer settings when on battery and AC power.[/p][/*][*][p]The mouse is now hidden in the overlay until there's mouse movement.[/p][/*][*][p]Wifi strength and connection type are now shown in the header on Windows.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed clicking the buttons in the footer causing the glyphs to change back to gamepad.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a clicking the back button in the footer not working if nothing on the page had digital navigation focus.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the Steam logo spinner moving during the login flow.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed cases on Windows where guide buttons presses would go to the main BPM window instead of opening the overlay in the game.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed cases where the main BPM window would not get focused when quitting a game.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed some cases where the onscreen keyboard would drop presses during dual trackpad typing.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the diacritic options menu interactions during dual trackpad typing.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the on-screen keyboard not popping up in non-Steam games after toggling wifi or suspending the machine.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed issues with trackpad typing if the trackpad is touched while the onscreen keyboard is opening.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]Steam Input[/b][/p][list][*][p]Added a new view in the configurator for Steam Input API games that lists out actions and their bindings rather than inputs to actions along with streamlined binding interface.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a new multi-binding page in the configurator for authoring button combinations that visualizes the timeline of command outputs and their settings.[/p][/*][*][p]Added support for the user-invoked On-Screen Keyboard in the desktop overlay.[/p][/*][*][p]Added information about which configurations are compatible in the configurator browser when using a game that requires Steam Input API.[/p][/*][*][p]Added the missing settings for adjusting emulated joystick adaptive centering on trackpad.[/p][/*][*][p]Added support for inverting button chord bindings.[/p][/*][*][p]Added support for switching into Lizard mode on the new Steam Controller when interacting with UAC windows or other places where Windows blocks Steam Input.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a landing page to the configurator when no file on disk could be loaded and give you the option to select a new configuration. This was one of the causes of a blank configurator.[/p][/*][*][p]Implemented a version of the "Reorder Controller" dialog for Steam Input API games. Note - this disconnects the controllers temporarily so older games which do not handle hot plugging properly can lose controller input.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved the display of cloud sync status in the configurator and give you the option to skip and proceed to the configurator. This was another common cause of a blank configuration because the layout was broken and the info offscreen.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved CPU performance at runtime and in configuration loading.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved the consistency of trackpad sensitivity between Steam Deck and Steam Controller.[/p][/*][*][p]In the desktop UI overlay the desktop config will now be applied. For most gamepads this will not be a difference in behavior because they have a blank desktop config, but Steam Controllers or devices that have setup a custom desktop config will have mouse input to click on things in the overlay.[/p][/*][*][p]On Linux switch to reshuffling gamepad input when the last running game exits instead of on game launch to avoid issues when running multiple apps at the same time.[/p][/*][*][p]By default, Steam Frame controllers will now use gamepad input in VR games that don't support VR inputs. The preferred mode can be changed for any VR game in either the game's Steam Input settings or in VR Controller settings on the Now Playing page. Please report any titles that do not work out of the box.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed pairing the 2015 Steam Controller.[/p][/*][*][p]FIxed glyphs for Switch controllers in Heavy Rain.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug on the Linux "Reorder controller" screen on Linux where sometimes swapping controllers would not work.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed issues with button and slider sizing in the configurator when opened in the desktop overlay.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Windows handheld controllers having priority over docked controllers in Steam Input API games.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the controller support widget showing "This game doesn't support controllers" for unreleased games that don't have controller support information yet.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed controllers not using the desktop configuration on the desktop UI login window.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed older-unnamed Virtual Menus showing up as "Create Virtual Menu" in some views.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed showing doubled Xbox style controllers on Windows.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed showing doubled Steam Controllers on macOS.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the glyphs shown for the Xbox Elite Controller paddle buttons.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed cases where the Virtual menu modes could show the wrong activation type if it was created in the standalone menu vs from a controller source.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]Remote Play[/b][/p][list][*][p]Added an experimental video codec, Pyrowave, which allows high bandwidth, low latency video streaming. You can find out more on the [url="https://steamcommunity.com/groups/homestream/discussions/0/564794422009744473?snr=2___"]Steam Remote Play discussion group[/url].[/p][list][*][p]Added the -pyrowavestats command line option to log Pyrowave encoding performance[/p][/*][*][p]Added convars @PyrowavePSNR and @PyrowaveHeightFactor to tune the automatic bitrate calculation (see [url="https://github.com/Themaister/pyrowave/blob/master/eval-results/objective-bitrate-evaluation.md"]https://github.com/Themaister/pyrowave/blob/master/eval-results/objective-bitrate-evaluation.md[/url] for details)[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Greatly improved Vulkan capture performance.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved color accuracy, clarity, and brightness.[/p][/*][*][p]Automatically fall back to H.264 if HEVC isn't available.[/p][/*][*][p]Disabled HDR when streaming to the OLED Steam Deck.[/p][/*][*][p]A PIN is no longer required to download an app to a remote device. A PIN is still required to Install and Stream from a remote device.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a Download Complete notification for a remote download if you initiated the download on your current device.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed EULA acceptance when starting a Remote Stream.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed streaming launch failing if the host client had a cloud conflict.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a dialog to recover if your network isn't able to handle current streaming settings.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]Linux:[/b][/p][list][*][p]The "Select compatibility tool" dropdown is now always visible.[/p][list][*][p]The recommended compatibility tool, or steam runtime for native games, now shows at the top of the list as the "Default" option.[/p][/*][*][p]Compatibility tool aliases, e.g. "Proton Stable", can now be selected from this dropdown.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][list][*][p]Windows binaries registered as non-steam games will now run in Proton by default.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a case where non-steam games would fail to launch after changing the Target binary via the Browse button.[/p][/*][*][p]The SteamOS compatibility dialogs will now show in desktopUI when installing games not verified for that HW.[/p][/*][*][p]On Desktop Linux we will now show the SteamOS unsupported dialog when installing games that are known to not work with Proton.[/p][/*][*][p]Improve download speeds on high latency connections.[/p][/*][*][p]Improve distro information collection for hardware survey, preferring data from /etc/os-release.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where virtual gamepads were torn down temporarily when a game called the ISteamUtils::SetGameLauncherMode api, which could cause titles that don't support controller hotplugging to lose input.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a case where the 'Stop' button would fail to close the game if it was launched by an external tool.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]Steam Controller Firmware[/b][/p][list][*][p]Added a 2nd BLE pairing slot - to pair hold L1 + B + Steam when powering on the controller. To switch between slots hold either L1 + B + Steam at start up or R1 + B + Steam at start up.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved rumble emulation and added configurable intensity levels.[/p][/*][*][p]Improve the time needed to fully connect the device in Steam.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where some Bluetooth BLE connections could disconnect repeatedly, especially on Steam Deck.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where pairing via a puck connection could fail.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where switching to BLE mode would stick, even if the host device could not be found.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where certain thumbsticks could lose the ability to reach full range.[/p][/*][/list]

newsitems.title: Steam Client Update - September 1st
newsitems.author: mikela
newsitems.contents:
[p]A new Steam Client update has been released and will be automatically downloaded.[/p][p][/p][p]Note: This client was re-released September 6th with the following additional changes:[/p][list][*][p]Fixed a case where the steamwebhelper process could experience high CPU usage when certain events were shown in the library tab.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Steam streaming client failing to launch on Windows 10.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]General[/b][/p][list][*][p]Allow changing account while a game is running. In this case, the change account dialog shows a warning that proceeding will close active games.[/p][/*][*][p]Added "Ask which account to use on startup" toggle to startup account chooser.[/p][/*][*][p]Eliminated "change account" confirmation dialog in most cases. Changing account while Steam is running now brings up the account chooser directly, then restarts as the chosen account.[/p][/*][*][p]Steam shutdown now waits for just-exited games to finish cloud sync.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed issues where some Steam Workshop items were not being updated properly.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed game server browser filtering out multiple servers being hosted from a single public IP.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where sometimes uninstalling a game would not remove it from the download queue[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]Friends & Chat[/b][/p][list][*][p]Chat messages with suspicious content will now be flagged in group chats. You can report the messages, block the sender, or dismiss the warning by clicking the notice.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]Big Picture Mode[/b][/p][list][*][p]In the Web Browser, the left trackpad of Steam Deck/Steam Controller is now bound to scroll wheel for navigating non-Steam websites.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where a single pixel line would sometimes appear above the header on the home screen.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]Remote Play[/b][/p][list][*][p]Improved video color range on all platforms.[/p][/*][*][p]Added support for HDR streaming on Steam Deck OLED.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a case where streaming could show a black window.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where Remote Devices with Remote Play enabled weren't showing as Streamable.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed video frame being clipped when using pipewire capture with desktop scaling on Wayland.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed framerate drop when using the unlimited bandwidth option with VA-API encoding on Linux.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]Steam Input[/b][/p][list][*][p]Make controller configurations that are shared with other devices or unique to a device more clear in the configurator UI and add an option to split Steam Controller configurations so they are no longer shared with Steam Deck.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p][b]Linux[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed some keys not typing properly in Steam Overlay when in Big Picture Mode.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a crash when suspending/resuming a device after a controller disconnected.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]
[/b][/p]
